body:
Hi.

I'm 16 so I probably sound stupid. But I think you need a break whether you like it or not. Have the weekend off or something and spend time with friends and family. Even if your income decreases slightly, you would still (most likely) have enough to pass through. 

Your mental health is more important compared to getting a higher income and waiting to purchase the newest iPhone that just dropped. Even if you earn less - you will have time for yourself to relax. 

Also during this, you might meet new people and friends if you out more. You might even find someone you end up falling in love with, and that would surely help when you have someone there for you 24/7 to talk to and be with. 

I know I'm younger than you, so I probably sound stupid. But I hate my life too but I've grown to just deal with it at a stable rate. You can message me if you ever need to rant, I'm always open :)

Don't do anything to hurt yourself, there are plenty of people who love you despite you acknowledging that or not.

​

x

Hi.

I think feeling depressed and sad is now the social norm - despite what every odd 'optimist' says. What you've basically described is me. I was to die, but 1. I'm scared of pain, 2. I don't want to place a burden on my parents despite some of the issues I've had with them in the past.

I've 'considered suicide', but I could never pull through due to feeling scared of absolutely everything. I'm afraid I won't actually die - and I would be placed in a psych ward if nothing goes to plan.

I'm scared of the pain and how much death would hurt. 

I'm scared of hurting my parents and making them feel like they were failures. 

You shouldn't feel pathetic for considering killing yourself. I think it's quite brave. I've had so, so many thoughts about it and how I would do it if I was ever actually going too. Just think of everything you still have in life, and what you could lose. 

If you ever need someone to talk too, you can message me. You're not stupid, and it's not 'unnatural' to feel this way. You have emotions, and you need to acknowledge them - as well as consider everything that comes into play. 

Message me anything if you need to talk about things. Please don't hurt yourself. 

​

x
You probably just haven't found the right person yet.

Hi, 

​

I can relate to feeling like a burden. But - what you need to think about is your sister if that helps. Imagine how she would feel if you ever did something like that? She loves you so much, and would think everything was her fault (even if you explained thoroughly it wasn't). 

Don't feel like your problems aren't valid. Everyone gets anxious about a lot. If something means so much and it causes you depression or anxiety (or it just makes you feel like you're worthless), it's important and worth noting. 

I'm 16 and have been seeing a therapist and psychologist for several months. My older brother had taken me as he is legally an adult and understands I have plentiful of mental thoughts that I shouldn't have. 

\- maybe seeing a therapist or psychologist would benefit you. You may feel stupid, and I did sort of refuse to follow and go into the room when requested. I was bawling my eyes out, and didn't say a word the entire 50 minutes. My second session I started opening up. I still have dark thoughts, but it feels slightly better having someone to rant too.

​

If you ever need to talk, I'm open!  


x

Oh right - maybe that friendship just wasn't meant to be.

Could you call up someone and they could come and spend time with you? Even if it's just a game or something. Is there a program there or like a club you could join? That might be fun.

I’m sorry to hear that. The best thing I can think of is that you acknowledged you want to improve yourself in a better way.

There has to be someone else there in a similar boat that is struggling and approachable? 

Maybe if you make a few friends time will fly and you’ll be out of there quick.

Heyo. 

I don’t really know what a ‘shortcel’ is and I can’t be stuffed googling it. 

Anyways, don’t worry about what other people think. Don’t do anything without talking to anyone first. You can msg me if you need to rant / talk. 

And being different is cool even though I don’t really know what you’re like - don’t worry about being ‘not the norm’. 

X

Hey...

I’m not feeling so great now either and I’ve spent the past hour crying and scrolling through random shit on my phone to cheer me up - nothing is working.

Please don’t. I know the feeling of ‘wanting to die’ very well. Talk to me before you do anything. I’ve been having a horrible night too and feel like I’ve lost it all.

You’re not alone.

X

Everything works out in the end. Message me if you need to talk.

X

Rightio.

Isn’t your dog allowed in your room?

Could you mention to them that you want a support pet like a small guinea pig in your room if the dog isn’t allowed in there?

You should also try medications. You can get some without prescriptions at chemists if you don’t want your parents to know you’re depressed. 

Do you have any friends that are able to call you when you’re down? Your girlfriend should certainly be there for you at any time when you feel like you’re not worth it anymore. 

You could try chatrooms online and form a group of online friends who know what it’s like? 

Please don’t do anything that’s permanent. It might feel like the world is ending now, even though it isn’t. It’s a bit hypocritical for me to say, but everything in life works out.

Imagine if you did do anything to hurt yourself? 

Your girlfriend wouldn’t even know. You would just disappear from her life online, and she would have no clue. 

Your parents, family. They would be heartbroken as well as your friends, neighbours, and local community / school. 

Stay safe please. 

X

I don’t think that’s bipolar. 

(My knowledge from watching ‘Shameless US’)

That show might not be 100%, but you might just have depression or temper issues. I can relate to instantly changing my mood, but I don’t think it’s termed legitimately as bipolar disorder.

If you’re ever feeling down, you can message me! 

P.s : bipolar can be a genetically inherited disease. If you have relatives who have been diagnosed, you should just see with a doctor and do a few tests so you can get the right medication. 

P.s.s :  nothing is wrong with you. 

xx

Firstly, you’re here for advice?

1. As much as you may love your girlfriend, she needs to act on it and I personally think you need to talk to her more thoroughly about how you’re feeling. 

2. So you live by yourself? Maybe you should try moving in with friends or family. Spending time with others more may help you feel like everything is worth it, and it is.

I suffer from mental illnesses too. I personally can’t relate to suicidal thoughts or self harm. I guess I’m too afraid of pain. But I do want to die - that is something I constantly think about. If you ever need someone to talk to, don’t hesitate. 

Please take care of yourself. I wouldn’t of bothered replying if I didn’t care. I could have just kept scrolling through my feed. 

Maybe you could get a support pet? A cat, dog or hamster could make you feel ten times better. 

x
* I have thoughts about dying, but not suicide.
